title: Filipino-Style Goat BBQ
description: A flavorful and spicy BBQ dish featuring goat meat, inspired by Filipino cuisine.

ingredients.name: Herbal oil
ingredients.notes: such as coconut or olive oil

ingredients.name: Meat marinade
ingredients.notes: mix of soy sauce, vinegar, and spices

instructions: Marinate the goat meat in the meat marinade for at least 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the goat meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
While the goat meat is grilling, heat the herbal oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the kare paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Once the goat meat is cooked, brush the kare oil mixture on both sides.
Serve the goat meat with chewy rice and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
